From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Football tournament season
2026–27 Copa del Rey
Tournament details
CountrySpain
Date26 September 2026 – 24 April 2027[1]
Teams126
← 2025–26
2027–28 →

The 2026–27 Copa del Rey is the 125th staging of the Copa del Rey (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The winners are assured a place in the 2027–28 UEFA Europa League league phase. Both the winners and the runners-up will qualify for the four-team 2028 Supercopa de España.

Real Sociedad are the defending champions, having beaten Atlético Madrid in the final of the previous edition.[2]

The final will be held at La Cartuja in Seville in April 2027.

As across Spain, match times up to 25 October 2026 and from 29 March 2027 are CEST (UTC+2). Times on interim ("winter") days are CET (UTC+1). Matches played in the Canary Islands use the WET (UTC±00:00).

First round

[edit]

The first round will be played by 112 of the 116 qualified teams, with the exceptions being the four participants of the 2027 Supercopa de España.

This first round remains a single match, but a new criteria of geographical proximity was created to define which teams would face each other.

A total of 56 matches will be played between 27 October and 18 November 2026. All matches scheduled to occur on 28 October were postponed due to a train collision in Urda, Toledo.[23] The matches originally scheduled for between 3 and 5 November were postponed once again as a mark of mourning for the death of Tenerife player Jesús de Miguel.[24][25]

Draw

[edit]

The draw for the second round will be held on 23 November 2026. Teams will be divided in two groups.

This second round maintains the criteria of geographical proximity.

A total of 28 matches will be played between 1 and 3 December 2026.
